verdict: Organic engagement is softening across all three locations this week.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision came entirely from Google Business Profile — no paid campaigns are running on Meta or Google Ads. Combined, your three locations generated 376 GBP actions (directions, calls, and website clicks), but each location saw a notable drop in GBP activity over the last 7 days, with Forte Metals showing the sharpest decline at 89% week-over-week and three consecutive days of zero actions. Forte Metals' listing is being reviewed now for a potential visibility issue, as the simultaneous drop in search clicks and GBP actions points to something beyond seasonal slowdown. A listing and organic content audit is underway across all three profiles to arrest the decline before it extends further next week.

drop in Forte Metals' profile actions last 7 days versus the prior 7 — the sharpest decline this period
organic search clicks to O'Hare Precision this period, though down 51% in the most recent 7 days

watch_item.issue: Forte Metals' Google Business Profile went dark over the last three days — zero actions and zero search clicks simultaneously — indicating a possible listing suspension or penalty.
watch_item.fix: The listing is being audited this week to identify and resolve any compliance or visibility issue, with the goal of restoring normal activity before the next reporting period.
